The test image shows a tomato leaf with:
- Small, dark brown/black spots scattered across the surface
- Yellow (chlorotic) halos around spots
- Yellowing patches on the leaf
- Brown necrotic margins

Top candidates: **Bacterial_Speck_Of_Tomato**, **Septoria_Leaf_Blotch**, **Early_Blight**. Let me check reference images one at a time.
Bacterial Speck shows small dark spots with yellow halos - somewhat similar but spots look darker/clustered. Let me check Septoria next.
Septoria spots are circular with darker borders, less yellowing than test image. Let me check Early Blight and Bacterial Canker.
This is an illustration showing Early Blight with larger, concentric ring spots - less similar to test image's small dark specks. Let me check Bacterial Canker.

Bacterial Canker shows yellowing and browning but no small dark spots. The test image's combination of small dark spots + yellow halos points strongly toward Bacterial_Speck. Let me check a few more classes to confirm.
TSWV shows whole-plant wilting - not a match. Let me check Leaf_Mold and Late_Blight.
Leaf Mold shows diffuse pale patches - doesn't match. Let me check Late_Blight.
Late Blight shows large brown water-soaked lesions - not a match. Let me view a second Bacterial_Speck reference to confirm.

This second Bacterial_Speck reference (Bugwood_15.jpg) is a near-perfect match to the test image:
- Same scattered small dark brown/black spots
- Same yellow chlorotic halos and patches
- Same brown necrotic areas
- Same green tomato leaf context

All 8 reference views used across 7 classes. The visual evidence strongly converges on **Bacterial_Speck_Of_Tomato**.

**Summary of comparisons:**
- Bacterial_Speck_Of_Tomato: Bugwood_14 (good match) + Bugwood_15 (excellent match - small dark spots with yellow halos identical to test)
- Septoria_Leaf_Blotch: Circular spots with darker rings, less yellowing - partial match
- Early_Blight: Larger concentric-ring spots - doesn't fit
- Bacterial_Canker: Yellowing/browning without discrete small spots - doesn't fit
- TSWV: Whole-plant wilting - doesn't fit
- Leaf_Mold: Diffuse pale patches - doesn't fit
- Late_Blight: Large dark water-soaked lesions - doesn't fit
